comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body:
Landed. devenv/ builds a debian-slim container with sshd and a pinned Linux herdr 0.8.0 (release binary verified against its published sha256, not a source build), reachable at ssh -p 2222 dev@localhost via ./devenv/devenv up.

Acceptance was the probe itself: tools/herdr-probe/probe --remote runs all six scenarios against the container's daemon through an SSH socket forward, and diff-corpus reports 0 differences against the macOS corpus. Identical attach frames, PTY handling, done derivation, and refused key names.

Fake agents come from tools/herdr-probe/fake-agent rather than being duplicated, so local and remote fixtures cannot drift. probe-agent reports its state through the API; screen-agent installs as 'claude' and is detected from its screen.

Not done here: CI wiring. Nothing runs this automatically yet - that belongs with the ./dev script card (a_26Jyk8yxA), which is what CI is meant to invoke.

creator: Alexander Terp
description: Linux container under devenv/ reachable at ssh -p 2222 dev@localhost, running the Linux herdr build and a fake agent that emits recognizable working/blocked/done output. Emulates the work devenv AND serves as the remote-path IT fixture, locally and in CI.
title: devenv container: sshd + Linux herdr + scripted fake agent
